description: This Java class 'MeetingDataValidator' provides validation logic for meeting data in the Fineract project, including create, update, and attendance validation methods.

classes.name: MeetingDataValidator
classes.description: A Spring component class responsible for validating meeting data inputs for creation, update, and attendance operations within the Fineract platform.

methods.name: validateForCreate
methods.description: Validates the JSON command for creating a meeting, checking required fields and attendance details.

methods.name: validateForUpdate
methods.description: Validates the JSON command for updating a meeting, with optional fields.

methods.name: validateForUpdateAttendance
methods.description: Validates the JSON command for updating attendance details of a meeting.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws an exception if there are validation errors collected.

methods.name: validateAttendanceDetails
methods.description: Validates attendance array details within the JSON input.
